## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] New format adapter (e.g. OpenAPI, GraphQL)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality or CLI/API behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and passes `pnpm run check` (typecheck, lint, build, test).
- [ ] I have added comprehensive tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] If changing conversion behavior or adding an adapter, I have reviewed **information-loss implications** and ensured `FormatCapabilities` and `detectLoss` accurately reflect reality.
- [ ] I have added/updated relevant documentation (README, guides, or API docs).
- [ ] Generated outputs from tests or adapters are deterministic across multiple executions.
- [ ] Any potential breaking changes have been clearly documented and justified above.
